title: Very cheap looking in person.
text: Very cheap looking in person.. I was very excited about receiving these baskets but was disappointed when I did. My husband and I are redoing our bathroom and had plans to use the baskets as decorative baskets for our bathroom shelves. The metallic woven material made the baskets look cheesy and cheap. That's just my own personal opinion and taste, but doesn't take away from the actual quality of the baskets, which were in fact sturdy and well made.
